$pinsComment: Termux stable keeps publishing an older version beside a newer one. nodejs-lts 24.22.2 links libicuuc.so.78 / libicui18n.so.78, and the shell's RuntimeTree.REQUIRED_LIBS asserts those sonames after staging, so the snapshot must keep ICU 78.3 even though the rolling index already lists 79.1. Update this pin (and RuntimeTree.REQUIRED_LIBS) only together with a nodejs-lts rebuild.
